message.reasoning_content: We need correct answer. Question: "يبتدئ أجل الاستئناف:" meaning when does the period for appeal start? Options: A: from date of pronouncement if after in-person discussions in session with party or representative. B: from date of pronouncement if party or representative notified on day of pronouncement. C: from day of notification to person itself or in his domicile if not present. D: all options correct. Likely answer is D? In many jurisdictions, appeal period starts from day of notification of judgment to the party, which is day of pronouncement if notified then, else day of notification. So A and B are specific cases. C covers if not present. So all correct. So answer D.
